summary: Implemented the Tabs feature (uncommitted, unverified: I did not run tests or repo code, per instructions). Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py with Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs; UnderlineBar now yields one Text object with clickable_ranges click spans appended last and width moved to the fifth position; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style so click metadata is preserved; new docs/reference/tabs.md; new tests in tests/test_tabs.py plus appended cases in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py. Decisions to review: bar position uses the displayed index (matches acceptance criterion 11, differs from a literal find_tab_by_name index only with duplicate names); an empty label gets a one-cell flexible share; empty Tab name falls back to the label; search only runs for single-character keys; layout resolver unchanged because its Edge protocol already has min_size; the optional sandbox demo and mkdocs nav entry were skipped. Next step: run the test suite to validate.
